text:
Jenna (Finance): Heads up — month-end close coming up. Two items I need help with before EOD tomorrow: 1) Prepaid Dedicated contract (Invoice 6789, Acme Corp) for $120,000 received Feb 5 needs a deferral schedule under ASC 606. 2) Usage reconciliation for hosted API trials that ran in late Feb — FP&A estimate will likely require an accrual. Can owners confirm?

Marco (Revenue Ops): I can own the Acme deferral schedule. Plan: 12-month straight-line recognition starting 2026-03-01. Confirm GL mapping: Deferred Rev = 2201, Subscription Revenue = 4001? Also: contract includes 10% platform credit — how do we reflect that in the schedule? @Devon @Aisha

Aisha (Acctg): Confirm GLs above. Journal on receipt was/should be:
```
Dr Cash 1010 $120,000
Cr Deferred Revenue 2201 $120,000
```
Then monthly recognition:
```
Dr Deferred Revenue 2201 $10,000
Cr Revenue 4001 $10,000
```
For the 10% platform credit, treat as customer credit liability (2305) and apply as contra-revenue when consumed. We'll record a separate liability and reduce recognized revenue when credits are applied.

Devon (FP&A): I ran the usage model for late-Feb trials — projected additional usage rev to accrue = $8,500 (one-time adjustment). I attached the calc in the shared drive (link pasted in thread). We should post an accrual for Feb P&L and reverse in March after actuals. For the credit, treat it as a customer incentive; the 10% should reduce net revenue recognized over the contract term.

Marco (Revenue Ops): OK adding the 10% credit to schedule as a line item. Draft schedule (Acme Corp, invoice 6789):
```
Period,Recognize_Gross,Platform_Credit,Recognize_Net
2026-03,$10,000,$1,000,$9,000
2026-04,$10,000,$1,000,$9,000
2026-05,$10,000,$1,000,$9,000
... (x12 months total, net = $108,000)
```
Notes: gross recognition $120k, credits reduce net recognized to $108k over 12 months. Will include contract start/end dates and PO ref.

billing-bot: Invoice 6789 paid via Stripe on 2026-02-05 14:12 UTC. Payment ID: pay_3LzX... Amount: $120,000. Recorded to bank feed.

Aisha (Acctg): I'll book the Feb accrual for hosting usage of $8,500 as:
```
Dr Expense (Hosting) 5XXX $8,500
Cr Accrued Liabilities 2109 $8,500
```
and then reverse in March when actuals hit. Also will create deferred revenue schedule under the Deferrals sub-ledger and attach to the invoice.

Devon (FP&A): I approve the $8.5k accrual and the 12-month schedule with the 10% customer credit applied as contra. I'll upload the supporting workbook to the close folder.

Jenna (Finance): Perfect — action items: @Marco produce final schedule + upload to deferrals spreadsheet; @Aisha post accrual and create deferral record; @Devon attach backup workbook. Please confirm in this thread when done. If anyone sees a different interpretation under ASC 606 for incentives, flag now. :thumbsup:

Marco (Revenue Ops): On it — will post final schedule by 15:00 PT today. :white_check_mark:

Aisha (Acctg): Accrual posted and deferral record created. JE ref: JE-2026-0245.

Devon (FP&A): Backup uploaded (Close/Feb/usage_estimate.xlsx).

Jenna (Finance): Thanks all — closing loop. Will include these entries in the month-end close checklist and notify auditors in tomorrow's packet. :lock:
